title: v0.40.10
description: NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B is NVIDIA’s smaller, Gemma 4-based vision-language model for fast local conversations, image understanding, and tool use. It supports a 128K-token context window. The model includes a DFlash draft for speculative decoding. ollama run nemotron-3.5-bolt:e4b Full Changelog : v0.40.9...v0.40.10

title: v0.40.10-rc0: Update gemma renderers (#19241)
description: renderers: add gemma4-nemotron renderer Add a Gemma 4 renderer variant that renders assistant content before its tool calls rather than after the tool responses. Models opt in with RENDERER gemma4-nemotron; gemma4 auto-detection is unchanged. Adds the corresponding chat template as a test fixture for Jinja parity checks. mlx: support Gemma 4 targets with DFlash drafts Load a draft-owned output head when its config requires one, while preserving the target-head path used by existing DFlash models

title: v0.40.9
description: Speech Ollama can now generate speech with Phonon on Apple Silicon. ollama run plays text or a chat model's reply aloud as the audio is generated, and apps can stream audio through the OpenAI-compatible /v1/audio/speech endpoint. ollama run phonon " Hello from Ollama. " d3 decision models d3 brings vLLM Semantic Router's decision models to Ollama. title: v0.40.9-rc3: Support GA Gradium Phonon checkpoints (#19227)
description: Replace the prerelease checkpoint path with Gradium's GA format, including default-voice import and speech conditioning. Set the 0.40.9 minimum, update the speech docs, and test import, inference setup, and rejection of the old checkpoint.

title: v0.40.9-rc2: flint: fix replies with thinking disabled (#19216)

description: We were still using a pre-release, and the download site is flaky, so lets get current on the latest CUDA Toolkit for WoA support.

title: v0.40.8
description: Recursive Flint Flint brings Recursive's coding model to Ollama. It is designed for the work coding agents do across a repository: understanding unfamiliar code, tracing bugs, implementing features, and adding tests. Reasoning, multi-turn tool use, and a 262K-token context window support longer tasks across files and tool interactions. Flint is an Apache 2.0-licensed, 40B-parameter mixture-of-experts model with approximately 2.5B parameters active per token. In its release evaluations , Recursiv

title: v0.40.8-rc0: mlx: add Flint model support (#19181)
description: Preserve source tool JSON alongside decoded API values so Flint can retain numeric types and schema order in prompts. Existing API marshaling is unchanged. Assemble ModelOpt expert banks during safetensors import, and reject direct Flint NVFP4 creation before conversion. Other models retain their existing import and quantization paths.
